title: nazm.diagnostic/1
description: One diagnostic from `nazm check`, `nazm run` or `nazm build --json`. Output is one object per line on stderr.

schema.description: The shape this object is in. Present on every object, not in a header: a consumer may read any single line.

code.description: Stable. A code never changes meaning and is never reused, so matching on one is the supported way to recognise a diagnostic.

message.description: One sentence, without a trailing full stop. Prose: match on `code`, not on this.

primary.description: The span the diagnostic is about. Always present.

secondary.description: Spans that explain it — a previous definition, a conflicting branch.

help.description: Why, or what to do. Prose, and optional — `null` when there is none.

fixes.description: Edits that would resolve it. Empty when none is known.

end.description: Byte offset, exclusive. Equal to `start` for an insertion point.

replacement.description: The text to put in place of `span`. Empty means delete.

description.description: What the edit does, for a person.

applicability.description: `automatic`: correct whenever the diagnostic is; a tool may apply it unattended. `needs_review`: resolves the diagnostic and may not be what was meant.

precondition.description: When this edit is the right one. Present on every fix, including automatic ones, where it states what makes the edit unconditional.
